        "contents": "\n\nconst PersonnelGroupNode = memo( ( node: any ) =\u003e {\n  const { useUpdateNodeInternals, useNodesData, updateNode } = useMindMap()\n  const updateNodeInternals = useUpdateNodeInternals()\n  const [handles, setHandles]: any = useState( [] )\n  const nodeData = useNodesData( node.id )\n  console.log( 'nodeData: ', nodeData )\n  const type = nodeData.id.split( '-' )[0]\n\n  useEffect( () =\u003e {\n    if ( node?.data?.handles \u0026\u0026 node.data?.handles.length ) {\n      const { data } = node\n\n      setHandles( data.handles )\n      updateNodeInternals( node.id )\n    }\n\n    if ( node?.data?.concise ) {\n      updateNodeInternals( node.id )\n    }\n  }, [node, updateNodeInternals, nodeData] )\n\n\n\n  return (\n    \u003c\u003e\n\n      \u003cCoreNodeContainer id={node.id} className=' motion-opacity-in-0 h-full w-full' style={{\n        minHeight: node?.initialHeight,\n        minWidth: node?.initialWidth,\n      }}\u003e\n        \u003cCoreNodeContent\u003e\n          {/* \u003cp className='text-sm text-white font-nunito'\u003e{nodeData?.data?.input}\u003c/p\u003e */}\n          \u003cp\u003e|\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/CoreNodeContent\u003e\n        \u003cCoreNodeBottom\u003e\n          \u003cKeyFiguresIcon /\u003e\n          \u003cdiv\u003e\n            \u003cAiButton /\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/CoreNodeBottom\u003e\n      \u003c/CoreNodeContainer\u003e\n\n      {handles \u0026\u0026 handles?.length\n        ? handles.map( ( id: string ) =\u003e (\n          \u003cHandle\n            key={id}\n            type='source'\n            position={Position.Bottom}\n            id={id}\n            isConnectable={true}\n          /\u003e\n        ) )\n        : null}\n    \u003c/\u003e\n  )\n} )\n\nPersonnelGroupNode.displayName = 'PersonnelGroupNode'\nexport { PersonnelGroupNode }",

        "contents": "'use client'\n\nimport { ReactNode, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'\nimport { useAssistantRuntime } from '@assistant-ui/react'\nimport { useMindMap } from '@/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context'\nimport { XYPosition } from '@xyflow/react'\n\n/**\n * SmartGraph - A wrapper component that adds AI capabilities to the mindmap graph\n * by providing custom context to the Assistant UI runtime.\n */\nexport function SmartGraph({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n  // Get the mind map context\n  const mindMapContext = useMindMap()\n  \n  // Get the nodes and edges from the mind map context\n  const { \n    nodes, \n    edges, \n    activeNode, \n    addUserInputNode, \n    findConnections, \n    addNextEntitiesToMindMap,\n    organizeLayout,\n    updateNodeData,\n    fitView,\n    deleteNode\n  } = mindMapContext\n  \n  // Get the Assistant UI runtime\n  const assistantRuntime = useAssistantRuntime()\n\n  // Define functions that can be called by the assistant\n  const handleAddNote = useCallback((input: string, position?: XYPosition) =\u003e {\n    // Default position to center of viewport if not provided\n    const centerPosition = position || { x: 0, y: 0 }\n    \n    // Create a new user input node\n    const newNode = addUserInputNode({\n      input,\n      user: 'Assistant',\n      position: centerPosition\n    })\n    \n    // Focus the view on the new node\n    setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n      fitView({ padding: 0.2, includeHiddenNodes: false })\n    }, 100)\n    \n    return newNode\n  }, [addUserInputNode, fitView])\n  \n  const handleFindConnections = useCallback((nodeId: string) =\u003e {\n    const node = nodes.find(n =\u003e n.id === nodeId)\n    if (!node) return { success: false, message: 'Node not found' }\n    \n    const connections = findConnections(node)\n    return { \n      success: true, \n      connections,\n      message: &#96;Found ${connections.length} connections for node ${nodeId}&#96;\n    }\n  }, [nodes, findConnections])",

        "contents": "\n\nexport function DocumentSummary({ fileName, summary, onClose }: DocumentSummaryProps) {\n  const [textContent, setTextContent] = useState(\n    typeof summary === 'string' ? summary : 'Processing document...'\n  )\n\n  // Handle TextStream type if present\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const processResponse = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        // Case 1: It's already a string\n        if (typeof summary === 'string') {\n          setTextContent(summary);\n          return;\n        }\n\n        // Case 2: It's a TextStream from Vercel AI SDK\n        if (typeof summary === 'object' \u0026\u0026 summary !== null) {\n          // Check for TextStream interface\n          if (typeof (summary as any).text === 'function') {\n            const text = await (summary as TextStream\u003cstring\u003e).text();\n            setTextContent(text);\n            return;\n          }\n\n          // Case 3: It's a Response object (from fetch)\n          if (summary instanceof Response) {\n            const text = await summary.text();\n            setTextContent(text);\n            return;\n          }\n\n          // Case 4: It has a toString method\n          if (typeof summary.toString === 'function') {\n            setTextContent(summary.toString());\n            return;\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Case 5: Fallback\n        console.warn('Unrecognized summary format:', summary);\n        setTextContent('Unable to display summary. Unknown format.');\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error processing summary:', error);\n        setTextContent('Error processing document. Please try again.');\n      }\n    };\n\n    processResponse();\n  }, [summary])\n\n  const copyToClipboard = () =\u003e {\n    navigator.clipboard.writeText(textContent)\n    toast.success(\"Summary copied to clipboard\")\n  }",

        "contents": "import { BaseEdge, EdgeLabelRenderer, getBezierPath, useReactFlow } from '@xyflow/react'\n\nexport function FlowEdge( {\n  id,\n  sourceX,\n  sourceY,\n  targetX,\n  targetY,\n  sourcePosition,\n  targetPosition,\n  style = {},\n  markerEnd,\n}: any ) {\n  const { setEdges } = useReactFlow()\n  const [edgePath, labelX, labelY] = getBezierPath( {\n    sourceX,\n    sourceY,\n    sourcePosition,\n    targetX,\n    targetY,\n    targetPosition,\n  } )\n\n  const onEdgeClick = () =\u003e {\n    setEdges( ( edges ) =\u003e edges.filter( ( edge ) =\u003e edge.id !== id ) )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003c\u003e\n      \u003cBaseEdge path={edgePath} markerEnd={markerEnd} style={style} id={id} /\u003e\n      \u003cEdgeLabelRenderer\u003e\n        \u003cdiv\n          style={{\n            position: 'absolute',\n            transform: &#96;translate(-50%, -50%) translate(${labelX}px,${labelY}px)&#96;,\n            fontSize: 12,\n            // everything inside EdgeLabelRenderer has no pointer events by default\n            // if you have an interactive element, set pointer-events: all\n            pointerEvents: 'all',\n          }}\n          className='nodrag nopan'\u003e\n          \u003cbutton className='edgebutton' onClick={onEdgeClick}\u003e\n            ×\n          \u003c/button\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/EdgeLabelRenderer\u003e\n    \u003c/\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "originalContents": "import { BaseEdge, EdgeLabelRenderer, getBezierPath, useReactFlow } from '@xyflow/react'\n\nexport function FlowEdge( {\n  id,\n  sourceX,\n  sourceY,\n  targetX,\n  targetY,\n  sourcePosition,\n  targetPosition,\n  style = {},\n  markerEnd,\n}: any ) {\n  const { setEdges } = useReactFlow()\n  const [edgePath, labelX, labelY] = getBezierPath( {\n    sourceX,\n    sourceY,\n    sourcePosition,\n    targetX,\n    targetY,\n    targetPosition,\n  } )\n\n  const onEdgeClick = () =\u003e {\n    setEdges( ( edges ) =\u003e edges.filter( ( edge ) =\u003e edge.id !== id ) )\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003c\u003e\n      \u003cBaseEdge path={edgePath} markerEnd={markerEnd} style={style} id={id} /\u003e\n      \u003cEdgeLabelRenderer\u003e\n        \u003cdiv\n          style={{\n            position: 'absolute',\n            transform: &#96;translate(-50%, -50%) translate(${labelX}px,${labelY}px)&#96;,\n            fontSize: 12,\n            // everything inside EdgeLabelRenderer has no pointer events by default\n            // if you have an interactive element, set pointer-events: all\n            pointerEvents: 'all',\n          }}\n          className='nodrag nopan'\u003e\n          \u003cbutton className='edgebutton' onClick={onEdgeClick}\u003e\n            ×\n          \u003c/button\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/EdgeLabelRenderer\u003e\n    \u003c/\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "# Mind Map Node Creation Fix\n\n## Problem\nWhen adding nodes to the mind map, the results were being populated into the &#96;user-input-node.tsx&#96; as entity data instead of creating separate &#96;entity-node.tsx&#96; components. This meant that entities appeared as a list within the user input node rather than as independent, interactive nodes on the graph.\n\n## Root Cause\nThe issue was in two main functions in &#96;mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx&#96;:\n\n1. **&#96;handleLoadingRecords&#96;** - Was updating the user input node with entity data instead of creating separate entity nodes\n2. **&#96;runSearch&#96;** - Was only creating a single child node instead of multiple entity nodes for all results\n\nAdditionally, the &#96;user-input-node.tsx&#96; was rendering entities as a list within itself rather than letting them be separate nodes.\n\n## Solution\n\n### 1. Fixed &#96;handleLoadingRecords&#96; function\n- **Before**: Updated user input node with &#96;entities&#96; data from &#96;flowData.xataResponse.records&#96;\n- **After**: \n  - Filters out &#96;query-result-node&#96; and user input node to get actual entity nodes\n  - Creates positioned entity nodes in a circular pattern around the user input node\n  - Sets correct node types (&#96;${type}Node&#96;) so they render as entity-node components\n  - Creates connecting edges between user input node and entity nodes\n  - Updates user input node with summary info and edge handles only\n\n### 2. Fixed &#96;runSearch&#96; function  \n- **Before**: Created only a single child node positioned below the user node\n- **After**:\n  - Collects all valid results (main record + related results)\n  - Creates multiple entity nodes positioned in a circle around the user node\n  - Creates edges connecting user node to all entity nodes\n  - Updates user node with summary of results found\n\n### 3. Cleaned up &#96;user-input-node.tsx&#96;\n- Removed &#96;hasValidEntities()&#96; function (no longer needed)\n- Removed entity list rendering section that displayed entities within the node\n- Removed unused imports (&#96;List&#96;, &#96;WorldMap&#96;, &#96;Events&#96;, etc.)\n",

        ],
        "originalContents": "# Mind Map Node Creation Fix\n\n## Problem\nWhen adding nodes to the mind map, the results were being populated into the &#96;user-input-node.tsx&#96; as entity data instead of creating separate &#96;entity-node.tsx&#96; components. This meant that entities appeared as a list within the user input node rather than as independent, interactive nodes on the graph.\n\n## Root Cause\nThe issue was in two main functions in &#96;mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx&#96;:\n\n1. **&#96;handleLoadingRecords&#96;** - Was updating the user input node with entity data instead of creating separate entity nodes\n2. **&#96;runSearch&#96;** - Was only creating a single child node instead of multiple entity nodes for all results\n\nAdditionally, the &#96;user-input-node.tsx&#96; was rendering entities as a list within itself rather than letting them be separate nodes.\n\n## Solution\n\n### 1. Fixed &#96;handleLoadingRecords&#96; function\n- **Before**: Updated user input node with &#96;entities&#96; data from &#96;flowData.xataResponse.records&#96;\n- **After**: \n  - Filters out &#96;query-result-node&#96; and user input node to get actual entity nodes\n  - Creates positioned entity nodes in a circular pattern around the user input node\n  - Sets correct node types (&#96;${type}Node&#96;) so they render as entity-node components\n  - Creates connecting edges between user input node and entity nodes\n  - Updates user input node with summary info and edge handles only\n\n### 2. Fixed &#96;runSearch&#96; function  \n- **Before**: Created only a single child node positioned below the user node\n- **After**:\n  - Collects all valid results (main record + related results)\n  - Creates multiple entity nodes positioned in a circle around the user node\n  - Creates edges connecting user node to all entity nodes\n  - Updates user node with summary of results found\n\n### 3. Cleaned up &#96;user-input-node.tsx&#96;\n- Removed &#96;hasValidEntities()&#96; function (no longer needed)\n- Removed entity list rendering section that displayed entities within the node\n- Removed unused imports (&#96;List&#96;, &#96;WorldMap&#96;, &#96;Events&#96;, etc.)\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "UI development should adhere to the established component patterns in the &#96;components&#96; directory. The project uses a combination of Tailwind CSS and custom components for styling. All UI elements must be accessible and follow consistent design patterns. The application features various animated and interactive components, particularly for timelines, 3D visualizations, and data exploration. New components should follow the established directory structure and naming conventions. Use the appropriate component categories (animated, backgrounds, ui, etc.) when adding new components.\n\n### Mind Map Node Creation Rule\n\n*   When a new node is added, the return content should not solely populate &#96;@user-input-node.tsx&#96;. Instead, the system must append three additional &#96;@entity-node.tsx&#96; components to &#96;@mind-map.tsx&#96;. If this is not happening, the logic in &#96;@mindmap-context.tsx&#96; should be reviewed.\n*   Specifically, the &#96;handleLoadingRecords&#96; function in &#96;mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx&#96; should create separate &#96;entity-node&#96; components for each entity, positioned appropriately around the &#96;user-input-node&#96;, and connect them with edges, instead of updating the &#96;user-input-node&#96; with the entity data. The &#96;runSearch&#96; function in &#96;mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx&#96; should also follow this pattern, creating multiple entity nodes for all results instead of just a single child node.\n*   Entity nodes should be draggable independently from the user-input-node. The &#96;parentId&#96; attribute should not be used to lock entity nodes to move with the parent user-input-node. The goal is to create a network/graph structure where the User-input-node shows the query, Entity-nodes are separate, interactive components, and Edges connect them logically.\n*   Entity nodes in the mind map should be freely movable across the entire canvas. The relationship between the User-input-node and Entity-nodes is conceptual (via edges) not spatial (within bounds), therefore the &#96;extent: \"parent\"&#96; property should not be used.\n\n",

        "contents": "export function BottomMenuAiWrapped() {\n...\n), select a model/entity, or enter a command (chat, search, etc.).\n\n2. **Command/Model Selection**\n   - User selects a command (chat, search, scrape, etc.) and/or a model/entity type.\n   - State is updated to reflect active command and selected model.\n\n3. **Action Dispatch**\n   - On Enter or form submit:\n     - If chat: Message is sent to AI, response is displayed.\n     - If search: Database query is performed, results are visualized in the mind map.\n     - If model selected with no input: Loads top N records for that entity type.\n\n4. **Mind Map Update**\n   - New nodes and edges are added to the graph.\n   - User input node is created for each query.\n   - Result nodes are positioned and connected.\n   - Node data is updated with results, errors, or status.\n\n5. **Persistence and Side Effects**\n   - Session ID and chat messages are persisted in \\&#96;localStorage\\&#96;.\n   - Errors are logged and displayed.\n   - AI messages can be saved as session notes.\n\n---\n\n## Key Functions and Hooks\n\n- **runSearch({type, searchTerm})**\n  - Checks for duplicate searches.\n  - Adds user input node.\n  - Calls \\&#96;initiateDatabaseTableQuery\\&#96;.\n  - Adds result node and edge if new, updates user node with status.\n\n- **handleLoadingRecords({data: {type}})**\n  - Prevents duplicate queries.\n  - Adds user input node.\n  - Calls \\&#96;xataToXYFlow\\&#96; for data and layout.\n  - Adds new nodes/edges, updates user node with results or errors.\n\n- **handleOracleAction()**\n  - Delegates to chat, search, or data loading based on command/model/input.\n\n- **handleKeyDown(e)**\n  - Handles Enter (submit), Backspace (clear command), \\&#96;/\\&#96;",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "export function BottomMenuAiWrapped() {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "  useAssistantInstructions"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62,
            "text": "\\&#96;/\\&#96;: Opens command menu."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63,
            "text": "- Handles both controlled and event-driven input changes."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65,
            "text": "### 6. **Dynamic Node and Edge Management**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66,
            "text": "- Adds, updates, and positions nodes/edges in the mind map graph."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67,
            "text": "- Computes child node positions relative to parent nodes for clear visualization."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68,
            "text": "- Updates node data with AI/database results, errors, or status messages."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "### 7. **Loading and Error States**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71,
            "text": "- Displays loading indicator when AI is processing."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72,
            "text": "- Shows error messages for AI or data loading failures."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76,
            "text": "## Data Flow"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78,
            "text": "### User Input → Command/Model Selection → Action → Mind Map Update"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80,
            "text": "1. **User Input**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81,
            "text": "   - User types in the Oracle input field."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82,
            "text": "   - Can trigger command menu (\\&#96;/\\&#96;), select a model/entity, or enter a command (chat, search, etc.)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84,
            "text": "2. **Command/Model Selection**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85,
            "text": "   - User selects a command (chat, search, scrape, etc.) and/or a model/entity type."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86,
            "text": "   - State is updated to reflect active command and selected model."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88,
            "text": "3. **Action Dispatch**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89,
            "text": "   - On Enter or form submit:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90,
            "text": "     - If chat: Message is sent to AI, response is displayed."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91,
            "text": "     - If search: Database query is performed, results are visualized in the mind map."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92,
            "text": "     - If model selected with no input: Loads top N records for that entity type."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94,
            "text": "4. **Mind Map Update**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95,
            "text": "   - New nodes and edges are added to the graph."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96,
            "text": "   - User input node is created for each query."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97,
            "text": "   - Result nodes are positioned and connected."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98,
            "text": "   - Node data is updated with results, errors, or status."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100,
            "text": "5. **Persistence and Side Effects**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101,
            "text": "   - Session ID and chat messages are persisted in \\&#96;localStorage\\&#96;."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102,
            "text": "   - Errors are logged and displayed."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103,
            "text": "   - AI messages can be saved as session notes."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107,
            "text": "## Key Functions and Hooks"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109,
            "text": "- **runSearch({type, searchTerm})**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 110,
            "text": "  - Checks for duplicate searches."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111,
            "text": "  - Adds user input node."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112,
            "text": "  - Calls \\&#96;initiateDatabaseTableQuery\\&#96;."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113,
            "text": "  - Adds result node and edge if new, updates user node with status."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115,
            "text": "- **handleLoadingRecords({data: {type}})**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116,
            "text": "  - Prevents duplicate queries."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117,
            "text": "  - Adds user input node."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 118,
            "text": "  - Calls \\&#96;xataToXYFlow\\&#96; for data and layout."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119,
            "text": "  - Adds new nodes/edges, updates user node with results or errors."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121,
            "text": "- **handleOracleAction()**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122,
            "text": "  - Delegates to chat, search, or data loading based on command/model/input."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124,
            "text": "- **handleKeyDown(e)**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125,
            "text": "  - Handles Enter (submit), Backspace (clear command), \\&#96;/\\&#96; (open command menu), and default search."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 127,
            "text": "- **handleChange(e)**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128,
            "text": "  - Updates input value, syncs with chat input if needed."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 130,
            "text": "- **handleCommandSelect(commandId)**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 131,
            "text": "  - Activates command from menu."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 133,
            "text": "- **handleFormSubmit(e)**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 134,
            "text": "  - Submits chat or triggers oracle action."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 136,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 138,
            "text": "## Integration Points"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140,
            "text": "- **Contexts:** Mind map state, session notes."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 141,
            "text": "- **Actions:** Database queries, AI chat, data transformation."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 142,
            "text": "- **UI:** Oracle input, command menu, model selection, chat/messages, error/loading states."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 144,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 146,
            "text": "## Extensibility and Edge Cases"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 148,
            "text": "- Easily extendable to support new commands, entity types, or data sources."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 149,
            "text": "- Handles duplicate prevention for both searches and nodes."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 150,
            "text": "- Robust error handling for AI and data loading."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 151,
            "text": "- Layout adapts to entity type for optimal visualization."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152,
            "text": "- Designed for both keyboard and mouse interaction."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 154,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 156,
            "text": "## Data Types"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 158,
            "text": "- **MindMapNode:** Represents a node in the mind map (id, type, position, data, parentId)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159,
            "text": "- **SearchParams:** Type and search term for queries."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 160,
            "text": "- **XataResponseRecord:** Generic record from database/AI."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161,
            "text": "- **CommandItem:** Command palette item (id, label, description, icon, prefix)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 163,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },

        "originalContents": "# Storybook Documentation Standards\n\n## Story Structure and Organization\n\n### Story File Naming\n\n- **Co-locate stories** with component files\n- **Use component name** + &#96;.stories.tsx&#96; extension\n- **Group related stories** in the same file\n- **Export stories** as named exports\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ✅ DO: Proper story file structure\n// PersonnelFileCard.stories.tsx\nimport type {Meta, StoryObj} from '@storybook/react'\nimport {PersonnelFileCard} from './PersonnelFileCard'\n\nconst meta: Meta\u003ctypeof PersonnelFileCard\u003e = {\n  title: 'Documents/PersonnelFileCard',\n  component: PersonnelFileCard,\n  parameters: {\n    layout: 'centered',\n  },\n  tags: ['autodocs'],\n}\n\nexport default meta\ntype Story = StoryObj\u003ctypeof PersonnelFileCard\u003e\n\nexport const Default: Story = {\n  args: {\n    personnel: {\n      id: '1',\n      name: 'John Smith',\n      classification: 'secret',\n      date: '1963-05-15',\n      rank: 'Captain',\n      serviceNumber: '12345',\n      organization: 'NASA',\n    },\n  },\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Story Organization\n\n- **Group by feature** in Storybook sidebar\n- **Use consistent naming** for story variants\n- **Include comprehensive examples** for all props\n- **Document edge cases** and error states\n\n## Component Documentation\n\n### Meta Configuration\n\n- **Set appropriate title** for component grouping\n- **Configure layout** (centered, fullscreen, etc.)\n- **Enable autodocs** for automatic documentation\n- **Add tags** for categorization and search\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// ✅ DO: Comprehensive meta configuration\n",

Visual Hierarchy**\n\nOrganize elements to guide users' attention to the most important information first. This can be achieved through:\n\n- **Size**: Larger elements naturally draw more attention.\n- **Color**: Bright or contrasting colors can highlight key elements.\n- **Typography**: Varying font sizes and weights can emphasize important text.\n\nFor example, using a larger, bold font for headlines and a smaller font for body text establishes a clear hierarchy. ([maze.co](https://maze.co/collections/ux-ui-design/ui-design-principles/?utm_source=openai))\n\n**2. Consistency**\n\nMaintain uniformity in design elements such as fonts, colors, and button styles across the interface. Consistency helps users predict functionality and navigate more intuitively. For instance, using the same button style for all calls-to-action ensures users recognize interactive elements easily. ([figma.com](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/ui-design-principles/?utm_source=openai))\n\n**3. Contrast**\n\nUse contrasting colors, sizes, and shapes to make important elements stand out. High contrast between text and background improves readability and draws attention to key components. For example, a bright-colored button on a muted background can effectively highlight a call-to-action. ([floatui.com](https://floatui.com/blog/elements-of-ui-principles-of-design?utm_source=openai))\n\n**4. Alignment**\n\nProper alignment creates a clean and organized layout, enhancing readability and visual appeal. Aligning text and elements consistently helps users process information more efficiently. For example, left-aligning text blocks and images can create a cohesive and professional appearance. ([floatui.com](https://floatui.com/blog/elements-of-ui-principles-of-design?utm_source=openai))\n\n**5. White Space (Negative Space)**\n\nIncorporate adequate white space around elements to prevent clutter and improve focus. White space helps in separating different sections and makes the interface more breathable and less overwhelming. For instance, adding space between paragraphs and around images can enhance readability and user experience. ([medium.com](https://medium.com/%40kingsoncreate/6-essential-principles-for-effective-ui-design-8570825fd7fd?utm_source=openai))\n\n**6. Feedback and Responsiveness**\n\nProvide immediate feedback for user actions to confirm interactions. This can include visual cues like button animations, loading indicators, or success messages. Responsive feedback reassures users that their actions have been recognized and processed. ([karlmission.com](https://www.karlmission.com/blog/principles-of-effective-ui-design-what-every-website-needs-to-get-right?utm_source=openai))\n\n**7. Accessibility**\n\nEnsure the design is accessible to all users, including those with disabilities. This involves using sufficient color contrast, readable fonts, and providing alternative text for images. Designing with accessibility in mind ensures inclusivity and compliance with standards. ([figma.com](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/ui-design-principles/?utm_source=openai))\n\nBy applying these principles, you can create a more effective and user-friendly interface. ",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nexport function AIMindMapProvider({children}: {children: React.ReactNode}) {\n  // Get mind map utilities from context and store\n  const {getCenter, updateNodeData} = useMindMap()\n  const {addNodes: storeAddNodes, addEdges: storeAddEdges} = useMindMapStore()\n\n  // Create a simple wrapper for the add nodes function\n  const addNodes = useCallback(\n    (nodes: any[]) =\u003e {\n      storeAddNodes(nodes)\n    },\n    [storeAddNodes]\n  )\n\n  // Create a simple wrapper for the add edges function\n  const addEdges = useCallback(\n    (edges: any[]) =\u003e {\n      storeAddEdges(edges)\n    },\n    [storeAddEdges]\n  )\n\n  // Initialize AI loading hook\n  const {loadRecordsWithAI} = useAILoading({\n    addNodes,\n    addEdges,\n    getCenter,\n    updateNodeData,\n  })\n\n  // Check if AI is enabled (has API key)\n  const isAIEnabled = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_HAS_OPENAI_API === 'true'\n\n  const contextValue = {\n    loadRecordsWithAI,\n    isAIEnabled,\n  }\n\n  return \u003cAIMindMapContext.Provider value={contextValue}\u003e{children}\u003c/AIMindMapContext.Provider\u003e\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Hook for tour-aware mindmap operations\n */\nexport const useTourAwareMindMap = () =\u003e {\n  const tourContext = useTourContext()\n  const mindMap = useMindMap()\n  \n  /**\n   * Add nodes with tour context\n   */\n  const addTourAwareNodes = useCallback((nodes: any[]) =\u003e {\n    if (tourContext.isTourActive \u0026\u0026 tourContext.currentTour \u0026\u0026 tourContext.tourProgress) {\n      const enhancedNodes = nodes.map(node =\u003e ({\n        ...node,\n        data: {\n          ...node.data,\n          addedDuringTour: true,\n          tourId: tourContext.currentTour?.id,\n          waypointId: tourContext.tourProgress?.currentWaypointId,\n          addedAt: new Date().toISOString()\n        }\n      }))\n      \n      mindMap.addNodes(enhancedNodes)\n      return enhancedNodes\n    } else {\n      mindMap.addNodes(nodes)\n      return nodes\n    }\n  }, [tourContext, mindMap])\n  \n  /**\n   * Check if a node was added during the current tour\n   */\n  const isTourNode = useCallback((nodeId: string) =\u003e {\n    const node = mindMap.getNode(nodeId)\n    return !!(node?.data?.addedDuringTour \u0026\u0026 node?.data?.tourId === tourContext.currentTour?.id)\n  }, [mindMap, tourContext.currentTour])\n  \n  /**\n   * Get all nodes added during the current tour\n   */\n  const getTourNodes = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    if (!tourContext.currentTour) return []\n    \n    return mindMap.getNodes().filter(node =\u003e \n      node.data?.addedDuringTour \u0026\u0026 \n      node.data?.tourId === tourContext.currentTour?.id\n    )\n  }, [mindMap, tourContext.currentTour])\n  \n  return {\n    ...mindMap,\n    addTourAwareNodes,\n    isTourNode,\n    getTourNodes\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "'use client'\n\nimport {useEffect, useCallback, useState} from 'react'\nimport {useAssistantRuntime} from '@assistant-ui/react'\nimport {MindMapBottomMenu} from './mindmap-bottom-menu'\nimport {useMindMap} from '@/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context'\nimport {COMMANDS} from './oracle-command-menu/commands'\nimport {ENTITY_TYPES} from './entity-types'\nimport {useAssistant} from '@ai-sdk/react'\nimport {useAIMindMap} from '@/features/mindmap/components/ai-integration'\n\n/**\n * SmartBottomMenu - A wrapper component that adds AI capabilities to the mindmap bottom menu\n * by providing custom context and function calling to the Assistant UI runtime.\n */\nexport function SmartBottomMenu() {\n  // Get the Assistant UI runtime\n  const assistantRuntime = useAssistantRuntime()\n\n  // Access MindMap context\n  const {\n    nodes,\n    edges,\n    activeNode,\n    addUserInputNode,\n    addNextEntitiesToMindMap,\n    updateNodeData,\n    getNodes,\n    getNode,\n    setNodes,\n  } = useMindMap()\n\n  // Track active command and model selection states to provide as context\n  const [activeCommand, setActiveCommand] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n  const [selectedModel, setSelectedModel] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n\n  // Get AI session status\n  const sessionState = useAssistant({\n    api: '/api/disclosure/chat',\n  })\n\n  // Add AI integration capabilities\n  const {loadRecordsWithAI, isAIEnabled} = useAIMindMap()\n  const {calculateCenterOfScreen, getNextId} = useMindMap()\n\n  // Helper function to extract all available commands\n  const getAvailableCommands = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    return COMMANDS.map((cmd) =\u003e ({\n      id: cmd.id,\n      label: cmd.label,\n      description: cmd.description,\n      prefix: cmd.prefix,\n    }))\n  }, [])\n\n  // Helper function to extract all available entity types\n  const getAvailableEntityTypes = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    return ENTITY_TYPES.map((entity) =\u003e ({\n      type: entity.type,\n      displayName: entity.displayName,\n      description: entity.description,\n    }))\n  }, [])",

A wrapper component that adds AI capabilities to the mindmap bottom menu\n * by providing custom context and function calling to the Assistant UI runtime.\n */\nexport function SmartBottomMenu() {\n  // Get the Assistant UI runtime\n  const assistantRuntime = useAssistantRuntime()\n\n  // Access MindMap context\n  const {\n    nodes,\n    edges,\n    activeNode,\n    addUserInputNode,\n    addNextEntitiesToMindMap,\n    updateNodeData,\n    getNodes,\n    getNode,\n    setNodes,\n  } = useMindMap()\n\n  // Track active command and model selection states to provide as context\n  const [activeCommand, setActiveCommand] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n  const [selectedModel, setSelectedModel] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n\n  // Get AI session status\n  const sessionState = useAssistant({\n    api: '/api/disclosure/chat',\n  })\n\n  // Add AI integration capabilities\n  const {loadRecordsWithAI, isAIEnabled} = useAIMindMap()\n  const {calculateCenterOfScreen, getNextId} = useMindMap()\n\n  // Helper function to extract all available commands\n  const getAvailableCommands = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    return COMMANDS.map((cmd) =\u003e ({\n      id: cmd.id,\n      label: cmd.label,\n      description: cmd.description,\n      prefix: cmd.prefix,\n    }))\n  }, [])\n\n  // Helper function to extract all available entity types\n  const getAvailableEntityTypes = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    return ENTITY_TYPES.map((entity) =\u003e ({\n      type: entity.type,\n      displayName: entity.displayName,\n      description: entity.description,\n    }))\n  }, [])",

        "contents": "'use client'\n\nimport { ReactNode, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'\nimport { useAssistantRuntime } from '@assistant-ui/react'\nimport { useMindMap } from '@/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context'\nimport { XYPosition } from '@xyflow/react'\n\n/**\n * SmartGraph - A wrapper component that adds AI capabilities to the mindmap graph\n * by providing custom context to the Assistant UI runtime.\n */\nexport function SmartGraph({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n  // Get the mind map context\n  const mindMapContext = useMindMap()\n  \n  // Get the nodes and edges from the mind map context\n  const { \n    nodes, \n    edges, \n    activeNode, \n    addUserInputNode, \n    findConnections, \n    addNextEntitiesToMindMap,\n    organizeLayout,\n    updateNodeData,\n    fitView,\n    deleteNode\n  } = mindMapContext\n  \n  // Get the Assistant UI runtime\n  const assistantRuntime = useAssistantRuntime()\n\n  // Define functions that can be called by the assistant\n  const handleAddNote = useCallback((input: string, position?: XYPosition) =\u003e {\n    // Default position to center of viewport if not provided\n    const centerPosition = position || { x: 0, y: 0 }\n    \n    // Create a new user input node\n    const newNode = addUserInputNode({\n      input,\n      user: 'Assistant',\n      position: centerPosition\n    })\n    \n    // Focus the view on the new node\n    setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n      fitView({ padding: 0.2, includeHiddenNodes: false })\n    }, 100)\n    \n    return newNode\n  }, [addUserInputNode, fitView])\n  \n  const handleFindConnections = useCallback((nodeId: string) =\u003e {\n    const node = nodes.find(n =\u003e n.id === nodeId)\n    if (!node) return { success: false, message: 'Node not found' }\n    \n    const connections = findConnections(node)\n    return { \n      success: true, \n      connections,\n      message: &#96;Found ${connections.length} connections for node ${nodeId}&#96;\n    }\n  }, [nodes, findConnections])",

        "originalContents": "'use client'\n\nimport { ReactNode, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'\nimport { useAssistantRuntime } from '@assistant-ui/react'\nimport { useMindMap } from '@/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context'\nimport { XYPosition } from '@xyflow/react'\n\n/**\n * SmartGraph - A wrapper component that adds AI capabilities to the mindmap graph\n * by providing custom context to the Assistant UI runtime.\n */\nexport function SmartGraph({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n  // Get the mind map context\n  const mindMapContext = useMindMap()\n  \n  // Get the nodes and edges from the mind map context\n  const { \n    nodes, \n    edges, \n    activeNode, \n    addUserInputNode, \n    findConnections, \n    addNextEntitiesToMindMap,\n    organizeLayout,\n    updateNodeData,\n    fitView,\n    deleteNode\n  } = mindMapContext\n  \n  // Get the Assistant UI runtime\n  const assistantRuntime = useAssistantRuntime()\n\n  // Define functions that can be called by the assistant\n  const handleAddNote = useCallback((input: string, position?: XYPosition) =\u003e {\n    // Default position to center of viewport if not provided\n    const centerPosition = position || { x: 0, y: 0 }\n    \n    // Create a new user input node\n    const newNode = addUserInputNode({\n      input,\n      user: 'Assistant',\n      position: centerPosition\n    })\n    \n    // Focus the view on the new node\n    setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n      fitView({ padding: 0.2, includeHiddenNodes: false })\n    }, 100)\n    \n    return newNode\n  }, [addUserInputNode, fitView])\n  \n  const handleFindConnections = useCallback((nodeId: string) =\u003e {\n    const node = nodes.find(n =\u003e n.id === nodeId)\n    if (!node) return { success: false, message: 'Node not found' }\n    \n    const connections = findConnections(node)\n    return { \n      success: true, \n      connections,\n      message: &#96;Found ${connections.length} connections for node ${nodeId}&#96;\n    }\n  }, [nodes, findConnections])",

Status: Implemented the first pass of the redesign directly in the target components with minimal, contained edits. I focused on the AI response panel, edge label capsules, personnel/testimony node cards, and the canvas background grid. I fixed typing and lints introduced by these edits; the code compiles cleanly at the linter level for the changed files.

What I changed
- AI Response panel hierarchy and header row
  - File: `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/nodes/enhanced-user-input-node.tsx`
  - Added a compact status header chip with an indicator, record count, and context expansion count; improved body text readability using clamp-based typography; consistent spacing and “Show more/less” logic.

- Shared node UI typography scale
  - File: `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/nodes/enhanced-core-node-ui.tsx`
  - Introduced clamp font sizing in `EnhancedNodeHeader`; added optional `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave` to `EnhancedNodeContainer` props and passed them through to the container.

- Edge label capsule styling
  - File: `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/edges/ai-animated-edge.tsx`
  - Unified to a pill/capsule badge with semi-opaque background, subtle border, ellipsis, and a title tooltip for overflow; improved type safety by defining `AIAnimatedEdgeData extends Record<string, unknown>` and `AIAnimatedEdgeType = Edge<AIAnimatedEdgeData>`.

- Prometheus note compact treatment
  - File: `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/edges/SiblingEdge.tsx`
  - Condensed the Prometheus annotation to a small rounded pill labeled “Prometheus note” with the full reasoning in a title tooltip; fixed context label parsing and ReactFlow node access (`getNodes()` vs `useNodes()`).

- Edge types cleanup
  - File: `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/config/edge-types.tsx`
  - Removed `baseEdge` entry which conflicted with `EdgeTypes` (resolved linter type mismatch).

- Canvas background refinement
  - File: `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/graph.tsx`
  - Replaced heavy dotted pattern with a subtle tech-grid SVG for a cleaner, more professional canvas.

- Personnel/Testimony cards
  - Files:
    - `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/components/cards/subject-matter-expert-card/SubjectMatterExpertCard.tsx`
    - `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/components/cards/testimony-card.tsx`
  - Personnel: switched to a clean photo-first frame with unified radius/shadow, clamp typography, and a compact “View” chip.
  - Testimony: made the quote the hero (blockquote with clamp type), simplified witness row with avatar/initial initial fallback.

Notes
- I kept changes scoped to UI structure and styles; no data/behavior logic was altered.
- If you want the AI response panel to also show contextual stats (e.g., “Found 3 testimonies records…”), pass `records` and `contextExpansionCount` in the user node’s `data`—I wired detection if they’re present.

Want me to proceed with:
- Storybook examples for `EnhancedUserInputNode`, edge label variants, and the two node cards?
- A toggleable Prometheus hover popover for richer reasoning on edge labels?
